name: Contact Persona Style V1.1
description: V1.0's residents with typing voices: each resident types like one of the kinds of people found in real chat logs (their own greetings, emoticons and slang), told how at the end of their prompt; replies come as a few quick IMs, with stock openers, tacked-on questions and long answers trimmed. The AIM prompt asks for shorter messages that react rather than interview.
